🌴 Welcome to MoVal, California! 🌴

⚠️BEFORE PURCHASING: This game features highly detailed models and requires a high end device⚠️

🌐 Supported on Mobile, PC, & Console. Heed the warning above.

THIS GAME IS IN BETA AND IS EARLY ACCESS. THERE ARE EXPECTED TO BE BUGS.

PC Controls:
[M] - Starter (Press again after the WaitToStart light goes away
[E] - Shift Up
[Q] - Shift Down
[W,A,S,D] - Drive
[H] - Horn
[L] - Headlights
[V] - Yellow Lights
[B] - Doors (Open with Yellow Lights on for Red Lights)
